info.title: Financer API
info.description: REST API: Axum router and services shared by the hosted server and the embedded on-phone backend

get.summary:
What the budget buys: how long your usual basket lasts per chain, the cheapest items that
fit, and the cheapest way to split the shopping.

parameters.name: budget_cents
parameters.description: Budget in cents. Default: what is left of this month's groceries limit.

parameters.name: days_per_basket
parameters.description: Days one basket lasts (default 7).

400.description: No budget given and no groceries limit set

get.summary:
Possible problems in recent payments: duplicate charges, amounts far above the usual, big
first-time merchants and charges that are large for their category. Dismissed alerts are left
out unless `include_dismissed=true`.

parameters.name: include_dismissed
parameters.description: Also list dismissed alerts (default false).

parameters.name: lookback_days
parameters.description: Only payments booked within this many days (default 60, 1 to 3650).

parameters.name: as_of
parameters.description: Treat this date as today (`2026-03-02`). Default: today. Mainly for testing.

post.summary: Dismiss an alert so it no longer counts as unread. Dismissing twice is fine.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: alert id from GET /v1/alerts

post.summary: Create a passphrase-encrypted backup of everything that is yours (see `/v1/export`).

400.description: Passphrase too short

post.summary:
Decrypt a backup and merge it like `/v1/import`. A wrong passphrase or damaged file is a
400 and changes nothing.

400.description: Wrong passphrase, damaged file or not a valid backup

get.summary:
The bank connections from `financer.toml`, with the state of each. The login is masked and no
secret is part of the answer.

post.summary: Stop waiting for an approval.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: connection name

post.summary:
Plaid: forget the connection. Tells Plaid to drop it and deletes the stored access token, so
the next sync starts with signing in again. The imported transactions stay.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: connection name

400.description: Not a Plaid connection

post.summary:
Start a sync for one connection: logs in, then waits (in the background) for your approval in
the banking app and imports. Send the PIN only when `pin_from_env` is false.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: connection name

400.description: PIN missing, or rejected by the bank

post.summary: Log in to the bank and ask for approval. Approve in your Sparkasse app, then call confirm.

400.description: Rejected by the bank, or a TAN method that is not supported

post.summary:
Check whether you approved in the banking app; if so, import. Answers 409 while still
waiting: keep calling every few seconds.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: sync_id

400.description: Rejected by the bank

put.summary: Replace your hand-maintained list of usual items (used in `manual` habit mode).

400.description: Unknown item, bad quantity or duplicate

get.summary: Monthly income minus fixed costs, from detected recurring payments.

put.summary: Replace all monthly envelopes. A category may appear once; limits must not be negative.

400.description: Duplicate category or negative limit

get.summary: The budget period you are in (or the previous one), from your payday setting.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: `current` (default) or `previous`.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description:
The day to treat as today, ISO format (`2026-10-11`). Defaults to today (UTC); the app
sends its local date so that a late evening is not already "tomorrow".

get.summary:
What you can spend per day for the rest of the period, with the breakdown: expected income,
recurring costs still to come, planned envelope money not yet spent, and spending so far.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: The day to treat as today, ISO format. Defaults to today (UTC).

400.description: Invalid date

get.summary:
Spent and remaining per envelope for one budget period (a calendar month unless a payday is
set in the settings).

parameters.name: year
parameters.description:
With `month`: the budget period that starts in this month (the calendar month when the
payday is 1).

parameters.name: month
parameters.description: 1 to 12; only together with `year`.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Instead of `year` and `month`: `current` (default) or `previous` budget period.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: The day to treat as today for `period` (ISO format); defaults to today (UTC).

400.description: Invalid month

get.summary: All items prices and recipes can refer to.
Download everything that is yours as one JSON document (no secrets, no prices).

Project the current budget period to its end from the recurring payments still due, the
average spending so far and the income expected.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: The day to treat as today, ISO format. Defaults to today (UTC); the app sends its local date.

400.description: Invalid date

post.summary:
Merge an export into this backend. Transactions and receipts already present (same
fingerprint) are skipped, so importing twice changes nothing. The budget and your usual-items
list replace the current ones when the export has any; settings are applied if present.

400.description: Not a valid export

get.summary: The meals planned for a week (Monday to Sunday), one per day at most.

parameters.name: week
parameters.description: Any day of the week; the week runs Monday to Sunday. Defaults to the current week.

400.description: Week out of range

put.summary:
Replace the plan of a week. Each day holds a bundled recipe by id, or a suggested recipe by
title with its ingredients, and the servings to cook.

parameters.name: week
parameters.description: Any day of the week; the week runs Monday to Sunday. Defaults to the current week.

400.description: Unknown recipe, day outside the week, duplicate day or bad value

get.summary: Items assumed to be at home (salt, oil, flour...); the shopping list leaves them off.

400.description: Unknown item or too many items

get.summary:
The shopping list for a week: ingredients of all planned meals added up (amounts scaled to the
servings and converted to packs), pantry items left off, priced per chain with the best split
and checked against what is left of the groceries budget.

parameters.name: week
parameters.description: Any day of the week to shop for. Defaults to the current week.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: The day to treat as today when looking up the groceries budget left. Defaults to today (UTC).

400.description: Week out of range

get.summary: Current prices per chain, cheapest first within each item.

parameters.name: item
parameters.description: Only this catalog item.

get.summary: For each item of your basket, the cheapest chain right now.

What a scanned barcode costs at Lidl, Aldi, Kaufland and Rewe: the best stored price per
chain, recent Open Prices observations, unit prices and the cheapest chain. A valid barcode
nobody has a price for answers `200` with no chains and a note.

parameters.name: ean
parameters.description: EAN-8, EAN-13 or UPC-A, with a valid check digit

400.description: Not a valid barcode (digits, length or check digit)

post.summary:
Fetch all configured price sources and store the result. A source that fails keeps its old
prices.

Upload text recognised from a receipt photo. Your usual items are learned from receipts
when the habit mode is `receipts`.

400.description: No items recognised

delete.summary: Disconnect Lidl Plus: the stored token is deleted. Receipts already imported stay.

409.description: Lidl Plus is not switched on

post.summary:
Finish the sign-in with the address Lidl's page ended on. Only the refresh token is stored,
encrypted. The first receipts are fetched right away.

400.description: Unknown or expired sign-in, or an address that is not the callback

409.description: Lidl Plus is not switched on

502.description: Lidl did not accept the code or could not be reached

post.summary:
Start a Lidl Plus sign-in. Returns the address of Lidl's own sign-in page; nothing is sent to
Lidl by this call. Experimental and unofficial: see docs/RECEIPT_SOURCES.md.

409.description: Lidl Plus is not switched on

get.summary: Whether Lidl Plus is connected, when it last synced and how many receipts came from it.

post.summary:
Scan a receipt photo or a digital receipt PDF (a Rewe eBon or Lidl Plus receipt exported from
their app or email): a model that can read documents (Claude or OpenAI, as configured) transcribes it
and the transcript is parsed like pasted text. The photo is sent to that provider.

400.description: Not a usable image, or no items found on it

502.description: The provider failed or cannot read images

get.summary:
The receipt sources: the mailbox, the Lidl Plus account and the watched folder, with state,
last run, receipts imported and the last error. Never contains a password or token.

post.summary:
Run the enabled receipt sources now (or just one). New receipts are linked to bank
transactions where that is unambiguous. `409` while another sync is running.

400.description: Unknown source

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Receipt id

get.summary:
Bundled recipes ranked by how much of them you already buy, what is on offer and what the
rest costs.

parameters.name: budget_cents
parameters.description: Hide recipes whose missing ingredients cost more than this.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Only recipes with this tag, e.g. `vegetarisch`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: At most this many (default 10, max 50).

post.summary:
New recipe ideas from Claude or OpenAI, based on your usual items and current offers. Only
item names, the budget and your diet note are sent, never bank data.

502.description: The provider failed or returned nothing usable

503.description: No API key configured for the selected provider

get.summary: Payments that repeat on a steady rhythm and amount (rent, salary, subscriptions).
Your categorization rules in priority order (first match wins, before the built-in rules).

post.summary: Add a rule at the end of the priority order.

400.description: Empty pattern or bad amount range

post.summary:
Run the rules again over existing transactions. Transactions you categorized by hand keep
their category. Returns how many changed.
Set the priority order of all rules.

400.description: The ids are not every rule exactly once

put.summary: Replace a rule's fields; its place in the order stays.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Rule id

400.description: Empty pattern or bad amount range

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Rule id

400.description: Invalid value

get.summary:
What is spent at each supermarket chain in a budget period, ranked, with the share of all store
spending, number of visits, average basket, last visit and the change against the range before.
Groceries that no chain matched are in `other`.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: `current` (default), `previous` or `last_n`.

parameters.name: n
parameters.description: With `last_n`: how many budget periods, 1 to 24 (default 3), the running one included.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: The day to treat as today, ISO format. Defaults to today (UTC); the app sends its local date.

400.description: n out of range

get.summary: The purchases behind one chain's total (`other` for unmatched groceries), newest first.

parameters.name: chain
parameters.description: chain id from /v1/spending/stores, or other

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: `current` (default), `previous` or `last_n`.

parameters.name: n
parameters.description: With `last_n`: how many budget periods, 1 to 24 (default 3), the running one included.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: The day to treat as today, ISO format. Defaults to today (UTC); the app sends its local date.

400.description: n out of range

get.summary:
Recurring payments seen as a watchdog: what is due in the next days, price hikes, possible
duplicates, and subscriptions that seem to have stopped.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: How many days ahead the calendar looks (default 30, 1 to 366).

parameters.name: as_of
parameters.description: Treat this date as today (`2026-03-02`). Default: today. Mainly for testing.

get.summary: All transactions, newest first.

post.summary:
Ask your Claude or OpenAI model to suggest categories for merchants still left as
uncategorized or other. Only distinct merchant names (letters only) and the allowed
categories are sent; never amounts, dates, IBANs or purposes. Nothing is changed until you
accept suggestions.

502.description: The provider failed or returned nothing usable

503.description: No API key configured for the selected provider

post.summary:
Accept suggestions: one rule per merchant, then the rules are applied to existing
transactions.

400.description: A merchant without letters or a category suggestions cannot use

post.summary:
Import a Sparkasse CSV-CAMT export. Transactions are categorized, and rows that were
imported before are skipped, so re-uploading an overlapping period is safe.

400.description: Not a Sparkasse CSV export

get.summary: All split transactions with their parts.

put.summary:
Recategorize one transaction. With `remember`, the merchant gets a rule so its other and
future transactions follow.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Transaction id

400.description: Nothing to remember: the transaction has no merchant name

put.summary:
Split a transaction into parts with their own category. The parts must add up to the
transaction amount exactly. Budget and spending totals then use the parts.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Transaction id

400.description: Fewer than two parts, wrong signs or the parts do not add up

delete.summary: Remove the split; the transaction counts as a whole again.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Transaction id

404.description: No such transaction, or it is not split

rules_saved.description: Rules created or updated (one per accepted merchant).

transactions_changed.description: Transactions that changed category as a result.

oneOf.description: Best way to buy the basket, if every item has a price somewhere.

staples.description: Cheapest items that fit the budget (at most 20).

history_count.description: How many earlier charges the comparison is based on.

kind.description:
`duplicate_charge`, `unusual_amount`, `new_merchant` or `large_for_category`. The app labels
these in the user's language; `reason` is the English explanation with the numbers.

reference_cents.description: What it is compared with (earlier charge, median, threshold), positive.

unread_count.description: Alerts that are not dismissed (also when `include_dismissed` is set).

changed.description: Transactions whose category changed. Transactions you categorized by hand are skipped.

passphrase.description: At least 8 characters. Not stored anywhere: without it the backup cannot be opened.

data_base64.description: The encrypted backup, base64-encoded, as returned by the create endpoint.

BankConnectionDto.description: A configured connection. The login is masked; the PIN is never part of it.

accounts.description: Plaid: the accounts that were linked (put their ids in `account_ids` to read only some).

approval_expires_at.description: Unix seconds after which a sync waiting for approval, or Plaid's sign-in page, is given up.

last_sync_at.description: Unix seconds of the last successful sync.

link_url.description: Plaid, in `needs_link`: the page to open in the browser to sign in to your bank.

linked.description:
Plaid: false until you have signed in to your bank once (press Sync now to start that);
always true for FinTS.

message.description: The bank's approval text in `needs_approval`, the reason in `error`.

next_sync_at.description: Unix seconds of the next scheduled sync; absent for manual-only connections.

pin_from_env.description:
True when the server has the PIN (the environment variable named by `pin_env` is set), so
the app does not need to ask for it.

sync_due.description:
A scheduled sync is due but cannot start by itself because the server has no PIN: press
Sync now and type it.

sync_every_hours.description: Hours between automatic syncs; 0 = only when you ask.

blz.description: Non-secret details of the last sync, to prefill the form.

configured.description: False until the server has a FinTS product id.

last_sync_at.description: Unix seconds of the last successful sync.

source.description: `manual`, `receipts` or `starter` (a generic basket used until habits are known).

quantity.description: Packs of the reference size per shopping period (1 to 99).

remember.description:
Also create (or update) a rule for this merchant and apply it to its other
transactions.

others_changed.description: Other transactions that changed category because of that rule.

oneOf.description: The rule that was created or updated when `remember` was set.

baskets.description: Whole baskets the budget pays for.

missing.description: Basket items this chain has no price for.

ChainPriceDto.description: The best known price of the scanned product at one chain.

observed_on.description: Day the price was seen (Open Prices), if known.

pack.description: Pack the price is for, for example `500 g` (scope `item`: the reference pack).

price_cents.description:
Shelf price of the scanned pack for scope `product`, price of the reference pack for
scope `item`.

scope.description:
`product`: a shelf price seen for exactly this barcode. `item`: the cheapest stored price
for the catalog item (for example milk), per reference pack; not necessarily this brand.

source.description: `open-prices` for a live observation, or the name of the stored price source.

unit_price_cents.description: Price of one kg or l in cents, where the pack size is known.

missing.description: Names of priced items this chain does not stock.

total_cents.description: Price of the items this chain stocks.

ConnectionState.description: Where a connection is in a sync.

chains.description: One entry per chain with a known price, cheapest first.

cheapest.description: The cheapest chain; absent on a tie, or when the chains cannot be compared.

compared_by.description:
What the chains were compared on: `unit_price`, `reference_pack` or `pack_price`;
absent when their prices have nothing in common.

ean.description: The barcode in the form used by Open Prices (UPC-A gets a leading 0).

item.description:
Catalog key (see `GET /v1/catalog`), when the product is a known kind of item; usable in
the usual items (`PUT /v1/basket`).

live_lookup.description: True when Open Prices answered for this request.

notes.description: Plain-language remarks: what is missing and why.

observations.description: Recent Open Prices observations, newest first.

pack.description: Pack size as printed, for example `500 g`.

tied_cheapest.description: Chains sharing the lowest price when there is a tie.

ExportDto.description:
Everything that is yours, without secrets (no PIN, tokens or API keys) and without prices,
which are fetched again.

ForecastDto.description: The end-of-period projection. Amounts are integer cents.

days_after_today.description: Days after today until the period ends.

days_through.description: Days of the period up to and including today.

early.description: Only the first days of the period are over: the pace is a rough guess.

fixed_costs_due_cents.description: Recurring payments still to come this period.

grocery_daily_cents.description: Average groceries per day so far.

grocery_exhausted.description: The grocery limit is already used up.

grocery_limit_cents.description: The groceries envelope limit, if there is one.

grocery_run_out.description:
The day the grocery budget runs out (before the period ends), if it does at this pace.
When it is already used up this is the day it was crossed.

next_income_date.description: When the next expected income is due (before today when it is late).

other_daily_cents.description: Average other discretionary spending per day so far.

other_spent_cents.description: Discretionary spending that is not groceries.

projected_extra_spend_cents.description: What the current pace adds until the period ends.

projected_leftover_cents.description:
Income minus spending so far, fixed costs due and the projected extra spending;
negative when the period is heading for a shortfall.

duplicates.description: Rows already stored (same date, amount, counterparty and purpose).

imported.description: Rows stored for the first time.

skipped.description: Rows that could not be read, with the reason.

callback_url.description: The address the sign-in ended on, `com.lidlplus.app://callback?code=...`.

authorization_url.description: Open this address in a browser: it is Lidl's own sign-in page.

callback_scheme.description:
The address scheme Lidl's page redirects to after sign-in (`com.lidlplus.app`); an app can
watch for it, a person can copy the address from the browser.

state.description: Send this back with the final address to `POST /v1/receipts/lidl/finish`.

enabled.description: Lidl Plus is switched on in the server configuration.

last_sync.description: Unix seconds of the last receipt sync.

LinkedAccountDto.description: An account Plaid reported for a linked connection.

id.description: Put this in `account_ids` of the connection to read only some accounts.

mask.description: The last digits of the account number, when Plaid has them.

budget_cents.description: What is left of this period's groceries limit; missing when no limit is set.

estimated_cents.description: Cost of the priced items on the best plan.

left_after_cents.description: Budget minus estimate; negative when over.

unpriced_count.description: Items that are not in the estimate because they have no price.

available.description:
False when the stored recipe id is no longer in the dataset; such a meal adds nothing to the
shopping list.

recipe_servings.description: Servings the ingredient amounts are written for.

ingredients.description: Ingredients of the suggested recipe, as written for `recipe_servings`.

recipe_id.description: A bundled recipe (from `GET /v1/recipes`). Use this or `title` with `ingredients`.

recipe_servings.description: Servings the suggested recipe's amounts are written for. Defaults to `servings`.

title.description: A suggested recipe that is not in the dataset, e.g. an idea from `POST /v1/recipes/ideas`.

amount.description: Free text such as `250 g` or `2 EL`.

days.description: At most one meal per day; days not listed are empty. Replaces the whole week.

chain.description: Lidl, Aldi, Kaufland or Rewe when the store is one of them.

store.description: Store name as recorded, if any.

is_default.description: True until the list is saved for the first time.

items.description: Items assumed to be at home; they are left off the shopping list.

PeriodChoice.description: Which period to look at when no year and month are given.

PeriodDto.description: A budget period: from payday to the day before the next payday.

days.description: Length of the period in days.

days_left.description: Days left including the reference day (0 for a finished period).

payday.description: Day of month the period starts on (1 = calendar month).

saving_vs_next_cents.description: How much more the next-cheapest chain charges.

reference_pack.description: Pack all prices of this item are normalised to, e.g. `1 l`.

shelf_price_cents.description: Price of the product as listed on the shelf.

percent_bp.description: Increase in basis points of the old amount: 2002 is +20.02%.

since.description: First booking at the new price.

duplicate.description: True if this exact receipt was uploaded before (nothing new was stored).

reconciles.description: Items add up to the printed total; if false, ask the user to check the receipt.

source.description: Where the receipt came from: `manual`, `email`, `lidl_plus` or `folder`.

transaction_id.description:
The bank transaction this receipt was matched to (same chain, amount within a cent, date
within three days, and no other candidate), when there is one.

image_base64.description: The photo's or PDF's bytes, base64-encoded (at most 8 MB decoded).

ReceiptSourceDto.description: One receipt source and how it is doing. Contains no secrets.

configured.description: Has a setting in the server configuration (Lidl Plus always counts).

detail.description: Where it reads from (mail server and folder, folder path, account region); never a login.

imported_total.description: Receipts from this source in the database.

notes.description: Remarks from the last run, e.g. why a mail or file was skipped.

imported.description: New receipts stored by this run.

linked.description: Receipts newly linked to a bank transaction by this run.

source.description: Only this source (`email`, `lidl_plus`, `folder`); all enabled ones when absent.

text.description: Text recognised from the receipt photo.

coverage_percent.description: Share of the ingredients you already buy, 0 to 100.

missing_cost_cents.description: Full-pack price of the missing ingredients that have a known price.

RuleDto.description:
A user categorization rule. Rules run in list order; the first match wins and beats the
built-in rules.

max_cents.description: Largest amount that matches, compared without sign.

min_cents.description: Smallest amount that matches, compared without sign.

pattern.description:
Compared with the counterparty name after normalization (case, digits and punctuation
are ignored).

sign.description: Only expenses (`expense`) or only income (`income`); absent for both.

RuleInput.description: Fields of a rule when creating or replacing one.

ids.description: Every rule id exactly once, highest priority first.

SafeToSpendDto.description: The daily number and everything behind it. Amounts are integer cents.

available_cents.description: `income - spent_so_far - fixed_costs_due - envelope_headroom`; negative when overspent.

daily_cents.description: What you can spend per day for the rest of the period; never negative.

days_left.description: Days left in the period, counting today.

discretionary_spent_cents.description: Spending so far without the fixed costs already paid.

envelope_headroom_cents.description: Planned envelope money that is not spent yet (never negative).

fixed_costs_due_cents.description: Recurring payments still to come this period.

income_cents.description: Recurring income booked so far plus what is still expected this period.

income_detected.description: Whether any recurring income was found in the bookings.

pace_target_cents.description: The straight-line share of discretionary spending that may be used up by today.

text.description: What the model read off the photo, so mistakes can be spotted.

llm_model.description: Empty means the provider's default model.

payday.description: Day of the month the budget period starts on (1 to 28; 1 = calendar month).
Day of the month the budget period starts on, 1 to 28.

needed.description: What the plan needs, e.g. `750 g`.

pack.description: Size of one pack, e.g. `500 g`.

pack_price_cents.description: Price of one pack at the chosen chain; missing for items nobody has a price for.

pantry_skipped.description: Needed by the plan but on the pantry list.

per_chain.description: The priced items per chain, cheapest complete chain first.

oneOf.description: The cheapest way to buy the priced items; missing when no item has a price.

skipped_meals.description: Planned meals that could not be used (recipe no longer in the dataset).

unmatched.description: Ingredients that could not be matched to a known item.

unpriced.description: Items nobody has a price for.

saving_cents.description: What splitting saves compared with the single chain; zero when not splitting.

single_chain_total_cents.description: The same items at the cheapest chain that has all of them, if there is one.

stops.description: One stop when everything is bought at one chain, more when splitting saves enough.

parts.description: At least two parts that add up to the transaction amount exactly.

amount_cents.description: Same sign as the transaction (negative for an expense).

StaleSubscriptionDto.description: A subscription whose last charge is older than two periods: cancelled, paused or moved.

periods_missed.description: How many expected charges did not arrive (at least 2).

StoreSpendDto.description: One chain over the asked range, compared with the range before it.

average_basket_cents.description: Total divided by visits, rounded to the cent; 0 without visits.

chain.description: Stable id for `/v1/spending/stores/{chain}/transactions`; `other` for unmatched groceries.

change_permille.description:
Change relative to the comparison range in tenths of a percent (-333 = -33.3 %); absent
when nothing was spent there.

share_permille.description: Share of everything spent in stores, in tenths of a percent (123 = 12.3 %).

visits.description: Number of purchases (each booking is one visit).

chains.description: Chains with purchases in the range, largest first.

compare_is_partial.description:
True while the range is still running: the comparison then covers only as many days as
have passed, so that half a month is not compared with a whole one.

compare_start.description: The range the numbers are compared with: the same number of periods right before `start`.

end.description: Last day of the range, inclusive.

other.description: Grocery bookings that no chain matched (`chain` is `other`); always present.

periods.description: How many budget periods the range covers.

start.description: First day of the range, inclusive.

total_cents.description: Everything spent in stores (chains plus unmatched groceries).

StoresPeriod.description: Which budget period(s) to look at.

SubscriptionDto.description: One recurring outgoing payment. All amounts in the watchdog are positive charge sizes.

monthly_cents.description: What it costs per month on average (weekly x 52/12, quarterly / 3, yearly / 12).

monthly_total_cents.description: Sum of `monthly_cents` of the active subscriptions.

stale.description: Possibly cancelled or unused, reported apart from the active ones.

upcoming.description: Expected charges from today to `days` ahead, in date order (an overdue one comes first).

merchant.description: The merchant name as sent (lowercase letters only).

transactions.description: How many of your transactions carry this merchant.

merchants_sent.description: How many distinct merchant names were sent to the model.

skipped.description: Transactions left out (pending, or not in EUR).

pin.description:
The PIN, when the server does not have it (`pin_from_env` is false). Used for this sync
only and never stored.

SyncOutcomeDto.description: What a sync should do, to be reported in the connection list.

message.description: Why it failed (never contains the PIN).

bic.description: Leave empty to use the bank's own BIC.

days.description: Days of history to fetch (default 90, 1 to 365).

pin.description: Online banking PIN. Held in memory until you approve, never stored or logged.

challenge.description: Text from the bank, e.g. "Bitte bestätigen Sie die Anfrage in Ihrer S-pushTAN-App".

no_tan_required.description: True if the bank needs no approval; confirm right away.

amount_cents.description: Negative for money leaving the account.

confidence.description: 10 to 99; lower for charges further out and for overdue ones.

overdue.description: The expected date has passed and the charge has not been booked yet.

WarningLevelDto.description: How worried to be about the end of the period.

WarningReasonDto.description: Why the warning level is what it is.
